root_causes.description: product-catalog server-side p99 latency is pinned at the ~10000ms ceiling throughout the window while its error rate, CPU, memory and pod restarts all remain at normal baselines — a pure injected latency fault. As a shared leaf dependency of frontend, checkout and recommendation, this latency propagates up the call graph, driving callers to the same ~10s p99.

evidence.observed_value: p50=10000.000ms p95=10000.000ms p99=10000.000ms max=10000.000ms (mean=7716.873ms) — pinned at latency ceiling
evidence.expected_baseline: p99 well below 100ms for a healthy leaf service

evidence.observed_value: cpu mean=0.027 cores, max=0.040 cores — no saturation
evidence.expected_baseline: cpu_stress would show ~1-2 cores of sustained usage

evidence.observed_value: memory mean≈24446293 bytes, max≈24985600 bytes — stable
frontend p99=10000.000ms (mean=7594.447ms) — same ceiling as product-catalog
evidence.expected_baseline: frontend p99 sub-100ms; shows upstream propagation of product-catalog latency

root_causes.description: Alternative hypothesis: the ~10s stalls could be caused by CPU saturation on product-catalog. Measured CPU usage is only ~0.027 cores (max 0.040), far too low to stall requests for 10 seconds, so cpu_stress is not supported.

evidence.observed_value: cpu mean=0.027 cores, max=0.040 cores — no saturation
evidence.expected_baseline: cpu_stress requires near-limit cores (typically ~1-2 cores); clearly not met

root_causes.description: Alternative hypothesis: a failing downstream dependency of product-catalog. product-catalog is a leaf in the topology with no downstream dependencies, and no error traces or error logs were observed, so a downstream dependency failure is not supported.

evidence.expected_baseline: dependency failures produce downstream error spans

remediation_steps: Confirm and disable the injected latency fault on product-catalog (flagd fault-injection flag or tc netem / latency sidecar for the seed42 scenario) and roll it back.
Inspect product-catalog request handling for artificial sleeps or downstream I/O stalls to verify the ~10s delay is injected rather than a genuine backend slowdown.
Restart/roll the product-catalog deployment to clear any stuck latency condition; confirm its p99 returns to sub-100ms.
Verify frontend, checkout and recommendation p99 latency recovers to baseline once product-catalog latency is cleared (they inherit product-catalog's latency).
